Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "窗口只要求返还。", "name": "return_only"}, {"meaning": "窗口只要求销毁或永久擦除。", "name": "destroy_only"}, {"meaning": "同一义务允许返还或销毁二选一。", "name": "return_or_destroy_alternative"}, {"meaning": "返还是通常动作，销毁仅在来源所述授权下替代。", "name": "return_or_authorized_destroy"}, {"meaning": "返还与销毁均被要求，并可适用于不同材料范围。", "name": "return_and_destroy_distinct_scopes"}, {"meaning": "窗口有其他明确动作连接，须由逐字证据限定。", "name": "other_explicit_action_connection"}, {"meaning": "窗口没有实际返还或销毁动作。", "name": "not_a_disposal_action"}], "examples": [], "name": "disposal_action_connection_v2", "question": "判断供应窗口的动作连接，区分二选一、有条件授权替代以及不同材料范围上的返还并销毁。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“2.1.7 upon demand of the OSCE, to promptly return all Confidential Information (in whatever medium), together with all copies thereof or, where expressly authorised in writing by the OSCE, to destroy or delete all such Confidential Information and shall confirm to the OSCE in writing that such destruction or deletion has taken place.” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“5.2.1 return all Confidential Information including copies to the disclosing Party; and 5.2.2 destroy or permanently erase all copies made by the receiving Party and procure that anyone to whom the receiving Party has supplied copies destroys or permanently erases such copies and any further copies made by them.”"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disposal_disposal_action_connection_v2__28_31", "operation": "disposal_action_connection_v2", "unit_ids": [28, 29, 30, 31], "current_units": [{"id": 28, "text": " Volunteer acknowledges and agrees that all Confidential Information and similar items whether maintained in hard copy, electronically or on-line relating to CCPDT’s business shall remain exclusively the property of the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers and shall only be used by Volunteer for the purpose(s) permitted by the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers."}, {"id": 29, "text": " Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service."}, {"id": 30, "text": "Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed."}, {"id": 31, "text": "Volunteer Conflict of Interest  Volunteers shall avoid personal and professional conflicts of interest in all matters pertaining to the Certification program."}]}]}
